commit 22c3fc19ed90943b126b6528dc144e8fdc3abe6a
Author:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
AuthorDate: Thu Jan 8 12:40:18 2026 -0500
Commit:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
CommitDate: Thu Jan 8 12:40:18 2026 -0500

    Bug 2008742 - Fix collapse logic for feed validity check and cert exception button. r=arschmitz
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D278004

diff --git a/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/feed-subscriptions.js b/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/feed-subscriptions.js
index 0cbd4f4d75c..870f3ddb12e 100644
--- a/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/feed-subscriptions.js
+++ b/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/feed-subscriptions.js
@@ -2140,13 +2140,13 @@ var FeedSubscriptions = {
     el = document.getElementById("validationText");
     el.toggleAttribute(
       "collapsed",
-      aErrorCode == FeedUtils.kNewsBlogInvalidFeed
+      aErrorCode != FeedUtils.kNewsBlogInvalidFeed
     );
 
     el = document.getElementById("addCertException");
     el.toggleAttribute(
       "collapsed",
-      aErrorCode == FeedUtils.kNewsBlogBadCertError
+      aErrorCode != FeedUtils.kNewsBlogBadCertError
     );
   },
 
diff --git a/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/test/browser/browser_feedDisplay.js b/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/test/browser/browser_feedDisplay.js
index afeb0b47247..f3057485072 100644
--- a/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/test/browser/browser_feedDisplay.js
+++ b/mailnews/extensions/newsblog/test/browser/browser_feedDisplay.js
@@ -95,6 +95,19 @@ async function subscribeToFeed(feedURL) {
         EventUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter(addFeedButton, {}, dialogWindow);
         await feedButtonHiddenPromise;
 
+        Assert.ok(
+          BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(
+            dialogDocument.getElementById("validationText")
+          ),
+          "After adding a feed the validation text should not be shown"
+        );
+        Assert.ok(
+          BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(
+            dialogDocument.getElementById("addCertException")
+          ),
+          "After adding a feed, the certificate exception button should not be shown"
+        );
+
         EventUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter(
           dialogDocument.querySelector("dialog").getButton("accept"),
           {},
title: Bug 2008742 - Fix collapse logic for feed validity check and cert exception button. r=arschmitz
